title: Update babel from 7.8.3 to 7.8.7 to support Node.js 14 as development environment
body:
**Summary**

Updates babel from 7.8.3 to 7.8.7 to support Node.js 13.x+ (including 14.15+ LTS) as development environment.

**Result**

Closes #4639
